body.intro: I've always been that person who loses important things at the worst possible moments. Wallet missing before a flight, laptop bag nowhere to be found during a crucial meeting, passport vanishing right before international travel. After my third emergency replacement situation in six months, I decided to finally solve this problem properly.
body.tagsley: Then I discovered Tagsley. With over 12,000 verified reviews and claims about being the thinnest tracker that perfectly does its job, I figured it was worth putting to the test.
body.testResults: After seeing all the praise, I had to put it to the test myself to see if it truly lives up to the hype. Here's what I found.

customerReviews.text: I've been using Tagsley for about 4 months now, and it's already saved me twice. Once when I left my wallet at a restaurant (Find My showed exactly which table), and another time when it slipped between my car seats. The battery life is exactly as advertised. I charge it maybe once every few months. Worth every penny for the peace of mind.
